name: perfect-games
description: ✦ Perfect Games — 7 instant multiplayer browser games (Sequence, Ludo, UNO, Tic-Tac-Toe, Draw & Guess, Dumb Charades, Tambola/Housie). No sign-up, no database, no storage — rooms live in server memory and friends join via a room code or link. WebSockets, smart bots, pass-and-play, fully responsive.
